shared_elements: oversized blocky head on a columnar torso
cap / headdress-like block on top of the head
broad shoulders with no free-standing arms (arms held against the body)
torso rendered as a plain broad slab with a few surface markings
justification: Both depict the same general subject in the same specific form: a rigidly frontal, blocky anthropomorphic figure with an outsized squared head surmounted by a cap-like element, sloping shoulders and arms pressed against a slab-like torso, with the same vertical ordering of head over shoulders over trunk. The decisive difference is treatment of the body surface: A carries dense incised iconography (concentric discs, chevron bands, small face-like motifs, a ringed emblem on the chest) whereas B is modelled sculpturally with anatomical features (brow, nose, ears, nipples) and no applied ornament at all.
